description: Raised for stage-fatal enrichment failures: unknown run_id, missing prerequisite raw data, or an internal config-drift condition (e.g. estimate_sales encountering a genre_bucket value with no multiplier entry).
docstring:
Stage-fatal enrichment failure.

Raised by parse_raw_bundle (unknown run_id), run_enrichment (missing steamspy_all rows), and estimate_sales (a genre_bucket value absent from boxleiter_multipliers, which should be structurally impossible if map_genre_bucket and config validation are both correct, but is guarded defensively as a programmer/config-drift signal). NOT raised for ordinary per-row data-quality issues (missing features, non-game app_type, F2P revenue) -- those are handled via imputation, dropping-and-counting, or NaN, per the module's core design.
postconditions: An EnrichmentError propagating out of run_enrichment results in the run's status being set to 'failed' via orchestration's exception-to-terminal-status translation

edge_cases.input: run_enrichment called for a run with zero raw_games rows entirely
edge_cases.expected_behavior: EnrichmentError, not a silently-empty successful report

edge_cases.input: A genre_bucket value structurally impossible under current code but hypothetically produced by a future bug
edge_cases.expected_behavior: EnrichmentError rather than an unguarded KeyError leaking a raw dict-lookup traceback

unit_tests.name: test_missing_raw_data_raises
unit_tests.description: run_enrichment on a run_id with no raw_games rows raises EnrichmentError.

unit_tests.name: test_str_message_is_informative
unit_tests.description: str(EnrichmentError('no steamspy_all rows for run X')) contains the run_id.
